import math

def sph2rect(r, a, b):
    # Standard convention: a = theta (azimuth from x-axis), b = phi (polar from z-axis)
    return (r * math.sin(b) * math.cos(a),
            r * math.sin(b) * math.sin(a),
            r * math.cos(b))

def alt_sph2rect(r, a, b):
    # Alternate convention: a = polar angle from z-axis, b = azimuth
    return (r * math.sin(a) * math.cos(b),
            r * math.sin(a) * math.sin(b),
            r * math.cos(a))

TOL = 1e-9

def close(p, q):

theta = math.atan2(y, x)
phi = math.acos(z / r)

# Verify the given point maps back to (x, y, z) under the standard convention
back = sph2rect(r, theta, phi)
print("Round-trip original point:", back, "CHECK PASS" if close(back, (x, y, z)) else "CHECK FAIL")

# Target point under the standard convention: phi' = phi - pi/2
new = sph2rect(r, theta, phi - math.pi / 2)

# Norm must be preserved: |new|^2 = r^2 = 38 (exact in terms of 225/13 + 100/13 + 13 = 38)
norm_new = sum(c * c for c in new)

submitted = (-a, -a, math.sqrt(38) * math.cos(math.acos(5 / math.sqrt(38))))
print("Submitted answer evaluated:", submitted)
print("Submitted matches standard-convention result:", "CHECK PASS" if close(submitted, new) else "CHECK FAIL")
print("Submitted |v|^2 =", sum(c * c for c in submitted), "(must equal 38)")

# Alternate convention check: theta = polar angle, phi = azimuth
alt_theta = math.acos(z / r)
alt_phi = math.atan2(y, x)
alt_new = alt_sph2rect(r, alt_theta, alt_phi - math.pi / 2)
print("Computed (alternate convention):", alt_new)
print("Submitted matches alternate-convention result:", "CHECK PASS" if close(submitted, alt_new) else "CHECK FAIL")

# Final verdict: submitted answer must match under at least one convention
verdict = close(submitted, new) or close(submitted, alt_new)
print("FINAL:", "CHECK PASS" if verdict else "CHECK FAIL")
